metadata.subject: D1_HEALTH_DISABILITIES
metadata.title: Sjukdomar och funktionsnedsättningar
exclusions: no treatment instruction beyond emergency/help boundary

source_catalog.source_title: Transportstyrelsens föreskrifter och allmänna råd om taxiförarlegitimation
source_catalog.legal_reference: TSFS 2021:119, 3 kap. 18 § och allmänna råd till 18 §
source_catalog.notes: Primary curriculum authority for D1 Sjukdomar och funktionsnedsättningar.

source_catalog.legal_reference: Healthcare guidance on low blood sugar
source_catalog.relevant_chapter_section: Confusion/drowsiness may indicate low blood sugar; help with sugar if possible; seek emergency care if needed.
source_catalog.notes: Used only for practical awareness during taxi transport.

source_catalog.relevant_chapter_section: Asthma attacks can worsen breathing; smoke, strong scents and cold air can worsen symptoms; call 112 if breathing is very difficult despite medication.
source_catalog.notes: Used for transport environment and urgent-help boundaries.

source_catalog.relevant_chapter_section: During a seizure: protect from injury, time the seizure, do not put anything in the mouth, call 112 if it lasts five minutes or longer or recovery is poor.
source_catalog.notes: Used only for safe response during a ride.

source_catalog.relevant_chapter_section: Suspected stroke requires calling 112 immediately, even if symptoms are mild or pass.
Movement may be slower, starting movement can be difficult, balance and speech can be affected; symptoms vary.
source_catalog.notes: Used for mobility and communication awareness.

source_catalog.relevant_chapter_section: MS can affect walking, balance, vision, memory, concentration and fatigue; symptoms vary.
CP affects movement in varying ways and can involve muscle tension, involuntary movements, balance issues and communication aids.
source_catalog.notes: Used for assistance and communication scenarios.

source_catalog.legal_reference: Healthcare guidance on cognitive support aids
source_catalog.relevant_chapter_section: Cognitive difficulty can affect memory, concentration, orientation, planning and communication; aids can support planning, reminders and orientation.
source_catalog.notes: Used for practical support during transport.

source_catalog.source_title: Närstående till någon med en demenssjukdom
source_catalog.legal_reference: Healthcare guidance for support around dementia
source_catalog.relevant_chapter_section: Patience, time, respect and avoiding argument can support a person with dementia.
source_catalog.notes: Used narrowly for respectful route/passenger communication.

source_catalog.relevant_chapter_section: Psychosis can involve interpreting reality differently, hearing voices, feeling persecuted and difficulty planning or caring for oneself.
source_catalog.notes: Used only for calm, non-confrontational transport response.

source_catalog.relevant_chapter_section: Panic attacks are frightening, often last minutes and pass; calm breathing and a calm environment can help.
source_catalog.notes: Used for calm taxi response, not treatment.

source_catalog.relevant_chapter_section: ADHD can affect concentration, impulse control, planning, time and following instructions; needs vary.
source_catalog.notes: Used for communication and planning awareness.

source_catalog.legal_reference: Healthcare guidance on autism with intellectual disability
source_catalog.relevant_chapter_section: Structure, routines, clear language and visual support can be important; verbal understanding varies.
source_catalog.notes: Used narrowly for practical communication and predictability.

source_catalog.legal_reference: Healthcare guidance on severe allergic reaction
source_catalog.relevant_chapter_section: Severe allergic reaction can worsen quickly and require urgent medical help.
